# Apps by Bison

> Six apps for drawing, vector design, comics, ebooks, personal video libraries and retro games. Find practical tutorials for each.

## Authorship and naming

These are guides and product information from Bison, the developer of the six apps; they are not independent reviews or rankings.
Markdown is another representation of the same HTML content. Read feature limits, source attributions and version notes in the linked page. English pages are translations of the Chinese originals.
Internal keys come from the site product catalogs; they are content-association identifiers, not alternative store product names. Product names and store identities are documented by the app pages and their official App Store links.
[Chinese product data](https://github.com/AllLuckly/AllLuckly.github.io/blob/master/_data/apps.yml) · [English product data](https://github.com/AllLuckly/AllLuckly.github.io/blob/master/_data/apps_en.yml)

## Applications

- [Aquarell: Watercolour Drawing for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/aquarell/index.md): Draw on iPhone and iPad with Aquarell brushes, layers and palettes. Follow a beginner tutorial, then save a PNG, JPEG, layered PSD or native project. Product: Aquarell; internal content key: `pastel`; catalog version 1.0.6, checked 2026-10-27. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id1591340577)
- [ManYue: Comic Reader for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/manyue/index.md): Learn about ManYue comic imports, offline reading, WebDAV, SMB and personal comic servers, then choose a tutorial for your library. Product: ManYue / 漫阅+; internal content key: `man_yue`; catalog version 2.0.3, checked 2026-10-27. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6753895889)
- [VectorPaint: SVG Editor for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/vectorpaint/index.md): Create vector drawings and logos on iPhone and iPad. Learn VectorPaint shapes, Bézier nodes, SVG editing and image tracing, then export SVG, PNG or PDF. Product: VectorPaint; internal content key: `draw_illustration`; catalog version 1.0.8, checked 2026-10-27. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id1587272880)
- [Book Isle: Ebook Reader for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/nasbook/index.md): Learn about Book Isle local imports, WebDAV, SMB, OPDS, Calibre, notes and reading-data sync through a 60-tutorial learning path. Product: Book Isle / 书屿; internal content key: `nas_book`; catalog version 1.1.3, checked 2026-10-27. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6766198898)
- [iCouldPlay: Video Player for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/icouldplay/index.md): Learn about iCouldPlay local videos, SMB, WebDAV, FTP, media servers, subtitles and playback engines through 40 practical tutorials. Product: iCouldPlay / 云映; internal content key: `icouldplay`; catalog version 1.1.0, checked 2026-10-27. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6755653178)
- [Yearn: Retro Game Emulator for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/yearn/index.md): Learn about Yearn game imports, touch and physical controllers, save states, sync checks, display layouts and launch troubleshooting. Product: Yearn; internal content key: `yearn`; catalog version 1.0.2, checked 2026-10-23. [Official App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6756637059)
